'''Tarn's Lair''' is located in south-western [[Morytania]]. Its entrance is located in the [[Abandoned Mine]]. It is a complex [[Dungeons|dungeon]] with lots of the [[undead]], and features a [[miniquest]] to kill [[Tarn Razorlor]] called [[Lair of Tarn Razorlor]]. Completion of the miniquest unlocks the ability to enchant a [[Salve amulet]] and turn it into a [[Salve amulet (e)]].

After the miniquest, the lair is mostly visited for an [[Clue scroll (elite) - Dig under Razorlor's toad batta|elite clue scroll]] that directs the player to dig at the [[toad batta]] spawn inside, or for ironmen looking to kill zombies for early [[rune nails]] or [[ranging potion]]s.

Players '''cannot''' set up a [[dwarf multicannon]] within the lair. If players attempt to do so, a chatbox message will state ''This temple is ancient and would probably collapse if you started firing a cannon.''

==Requirements==
*The [[Haunted Mine]] quest is required to access Tarn's Lair.
*Level {{SCP|Slayer|40}} [[Slayer]] (cannot be boosted) if you wish to fight against [[Tarn Razorlor]].

===Optional===
[[File:Tarn's Lair entrance.png|thumb|The entrance to Tarn's temple, blocked by a boulder.]]
*Level {{SCP|Prayer|43}} [[Prayer]] to use [[Protect from Melee]].
*100 [[coins]] required each time to use the banker [[Odovacar]].
*Bringing food and [[prayer potions]] is highly recommended, especially for players entering the dungeon for the first time. Multiple traps and monsters that can deal constant damage are scattered throughout the lair.
*Gear with high Prayer bonus.

==Transportation==
The lair is found inside the [[Abandoned Mine]] and requires a [[Salve amulet]] to enter. 

*The fastest way to get to [[Tarn]] is to teleport to Tarn's Lair via a [[Slayer ring]]. This will bring you directly outside of the room with Tarn.
*The fastest way to get to the entrance through the Abandoned Mine is using the [[Morytania legs 3]] to teleport to [[Burgh de Rott]] and hop over the [[Low fence|Agility shortcut]] west of the town.

*Using the [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Shades of Mort'ton (activity)|Shades of Mort'ton]] or the [[Mort'ton teleport]] scroll will place you directly in [[Mort'ton]], which is north-east of the [[Abandoned Mine]].
*By [[fairy rings|fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|bip}} (50 [[Agility]] needed) and then walking south.

To enter Tarn's Lair, climb over the mine cart just south of the [[Zealot]] (featured in the [[Haunted Mine]] quest), go through the entrance of the [[Abandoned Mine]], and then head north of the entrance.

==Map==
Referring back to the [[:File:Tarn's Lair map.png|map]] above, note the letters that identify the various doors and passages.

The route to reach Tarn Razorlor is '''D-S-T-U'''.

The route to reach the spawn point of Razorlor's [[Toad batta]] is '''C-K''', which is used in a step for an [[elite clue scroll]]. The fastest route is through '''A''' and then using a  protruding wall trap to get pushed down into the hole on the east side as you exit, taking you to the small room just east of the Toad batta. Once there, you must search the wall trap in the corridor between the rooms in order to enter the room containing the clue scroll task.

Before you go off into this dangerous [[Dungeons|dungeon]], there are things you need to know. This lair is very dangerous if not geared properly, and is guarded by various monsters and traps.

==Directions==
[[File:Tarn's Lair.png|thumb|Follow this route to reach [[Tarn]], but beware of traps!]]
There are numerous traps, monsters and passages within the lair. 

'''Note:''' It is recommended that you have [[Auto Retaliate]] '''OFF''' whilst in the lair to avoid running back into traps or floor spikes if a monster is attacking you.

{| class="wikitable"
!Trap/Feature
!Failure result
!Notes
|-
|'''[[Floor (Tarn's Lair)|Floor trap]]'''
|You will be hit 7-8 hitpoints if you run over a floor trap
|They are fairly obvious, having a big X across the floor tile. Right-click and search floor to disarm the trap. Another simple alternative is to just carefully walk around them.
|-
|'''[[Floor (trapdoor, Tarn's Lair)|Trapdoor trap]]'''
|Standing on the trap will result in falling to a lower level and landing on spikes, being hit for 8 hitpoints
|They are also fairly obvious, having a line across the floor tile. The only way to avoid the trap is not stand on it.
|-
|'''[[Wall (Tarn's Lair)|Wall trap]]'''
|You will be hit 7-10 hitpoints if you run past a wall trap
|These are harder to see, but generally only occur in narrow passages, so check for them when you're in a narrow passage.
|-
|'''[[Hanging log|Log trap]]'''
|You will be hit 15-20 hitpoints by a log trap, and knocked to a level below.
|Log traps only occur on jumps to pillars. There is a nearby right-click [[Floor (switch, Tarn's Lair)|"Search" floor]] which will disable the log trap near one of the walls.
|-
|'''[[Wall (push trap, Tarn's Lair)|Receding walls]]'''
|You will be pushed by the walls, and knocked to a level below.
|Occurs sometimes on slim ledges. Just wait until the trap moves back into the walls and '''run''' past it.
|-
|'''[[Passageway (Tarn's Lair)|Passageway]]'''
|N/A
|Passageways lead to new areas in the lair. Following the more ornate doors (especially with water-features) will eventually lead you to Tarn Razorlor.
|}

==Bank==
[[Odovacar]] the banker allows players to access their bank at a cost of 100 [[coins]] per use. He can be found by travelling all the way east from the entrance, and then north, turning right when the path splits. Some of the undead drop coins when killed, and may also drop various weapons that can be alchemised for coins.

==Monsters==
[[File:Lair of Tarn Razorlor.png|thumb|Tarn in his mutant form with two terror dogs.]]
*[[Zombie (Tarn's Lair)|Zombie]]
*[[Skeleton (Tarn's Lair)|Skeleton]]
*[[Skeleton (mage)]]
*[[Giant skeleton (Tarn's Lair)|Giant skeleton]]
*[[Animated spade]]
*[[Possessed pickaxe]]
*[[Tarn]]
*[[Terror dog]]

==Personalities==
*[[Tarn Razorlor]] - A mad [[necromancy|necromancer]] who discovered the temple in search of the [[salve crystal]].
*[[Odovacar]] - The poor banker who was sent to the lair. He allows players to access their bank at a cost of 100 coins per use of his services.
